records.c: The panel IRQ at $1A89 selects this bank-zero character set. The panel alphabet is drawn as holes in character cells. The inverted glyphs at $E8-$F2 spell the panel headings and $F3-$FC contain digits 0-9.
Uses the 16-bit scroll position in $11/$12 and Y to rewrite source addresses and row offsets for the unrolled screen-copy loop at $109F. The copy moves stage tile indices into the VIC screen buffer.
Copies a column position across the unrolled set of playfield rows. The source operands are patched by the preceding setup and the first destination is $C400.
Halves the foreground scroll position, adds the secondary map base $9990, and patches the first two secondary-row readers at $1108 and $1113.

Composites foreground rows 6–15 in pairs. A zero index in a foreground row reveals the corresponding secondary row at half scroll speed. Foreground row pairs advance 800 source bytes and the secondary row pairs advance 440.
Advances both destination addresses by 80 screen cells, the two foreground offsets by 800 and the two secondary offsets by 440, then starts the next pair.
Copies panel screen cells from $3894–$395B to $06D0–$0797 and from $395C–$39AB to $0798–$07E7, in the VIC screen page at $0400.
Starts by writing colour eight to the corresponding panel colour RAM cells beginning at $06CF's colour-RAM counterpart.
Looks up the screen character index from each staged row at $C000 and following 40-byte strides, then writes the corresponding stage colour from $9200 to colour RAM at $D800 and following rows.

Patches the message pointer from X/Y, selects $C700 or $0440 according to carry and clears 128 bytes. It masks each of twelve characters to six bits and copies eight glyph rows from $3000 at three-byte strides.
Offsets used at $1354 to position the twelve message glyphs inside their sprite buffer.

Starts playfield setup by installing the line-zero IRQ at $16AD. Calls the level and player setup entry points, enables IRQs and waits for the game display to come back before falling into the restart path.
Runs the stage entry setup at $2A8A, sets $30 to one and calls the jump-table entry at $4000 before initialising the per-stage zero-page fields.
Scans the first fifteen X entries at $A230, retaining the smallest distance from the reference column and patching the index read at $152E.
Reads Y and X tile coordinates from the tables at $A240 and $A230, patches coordinate operands, and scales the X coordinate by eight before adding the screen origin offset.
Saves A, X and Y in $03-$05. Selects VIC bank $C000 via CIA2, loads the playfield's $D016 and $D018 values and resets sprite expansion, priority and X high bits for the top of the frame.
Services the sound path and uses the common IRQ tail to schedule $19AD on line $82.
Saves the interrupted registers in $5C–$5E, changes the raster comparator to $B2 and installs $1A59 in the IRQ vector. Acknowledges the current VIC IRQ before enabling interrupts.
Copies the playfield's $D011 value into the operand at $1A95 and schedules the panel IRQ at raster $C2.
Saves the registers, waits in a short fixed loop, then sets CIA2 bank bits to three and switches the VIC memory pointers and colours for the status panel.
Installs the shop raster handler at $21A3 for line zero, using the IRQ tail $791A.
Switches to the shop scene, applies the shop colour table, saves zero-page and sound workspace in $C000 and $C080, and initialises music selector six.
Uses the stage index at $998C to select the required scroll count from $73F9 and assigns it to the progress byte at $2709.

Decodes the heart colour from bits 3-5, searches the five stored colours at $02CD, and adds it when new. The fifth distinct colour displays the bonus message, clears the collection and invokes the life increment at $272C.
Compares the completed scroll count in the operand at $2709 with the stage requirement indexed from $73F9. The shop path branches to $20FE when equal.
Reads port 2 from $DC00. The low two direction bits move selection within six slots, including wrap from the end to the opposite end.
Uses the horizontal direction bits to change selection by three positions when the resulting index is in range. When both are released, tests fire separately.
Reads the selected item's two packed price bytes from $73C5 and $73BF and copies them to $73BD/$73BE for the price renderer.
Tests whether selection one is active. That path leaves the shop via $20BE. Other selections set the purchase latch at $2253.

Stores summary values for the completed-stage display, passes the banner pointer $72AF to the message routine at $269C, and waits for the raster chain's transition flags before loading the next payload.
Invokes the disk payload loader at $76D4. Tests the incremented load count at $02A7. At eight it calls the ending at $9080 and reloads payload one before restarting.
Runs the $4009 stage setup entry, waits for the IRQ-side transition latch to clear, calls $29F5, then returns to the stage entry loop.
Sets the shared transition byte $22B1 to one and polls until the IRQ side clears it.

Writes the top-of-shop display mode and palette, then populates sprite registers from the shop tables. Uses the current item and heart state to update selected sprites before the raster chain reaches the timed purchase code.

Subtracts the price from the three-byte packed BCD money at $02AB-$02AD. A borrow skips the purchase. On success, checks item restrictions, writes back the balance, refreshes the HUD, and dispatches the selected item's effect through a patched JSR.
Reads the active-low port-2 joystick from CIA1 port A. The next instruction stores the sample in $1C. With left and fire held the monitored read changed from $7F to $6B.

Gates the duck on active-low down plus fire and rejects the case with up, left and right all pressed. It checks movement and terrain state before setting $5B. With down and fire held on a stage-one snapshot the store at $2479 set $5B to one.
Tests the right bit then the left bit of the joystick sample. Right sets $14 and $1D to one, and left sets them to $FF.
With fire pressed and the stage path active, queues effect three at $5100 and sets the projectile flag at $18BF. Initialises the two counters at $73A7 and $73A8 before entering the movement tail.

Takes the low five joystick bits and tests for active-low up by itself. Compares position against different door-coordinate pairs in play and in the room state. The matching branches set the transition flags.
Splits the two price bytes at $73BD/$73BE into four nibbles. The digit helper multiplies each nibble by four and rewrites the shop screen template.
Clears six progress screen cells and, when progress is nonzero, selects the stage's letter stream from $73EB/$73F2. Copies the collected number of letters after masking each to six bits.
Increments the life count at $02AF unless it is already nine, then refreshes its displayed digit.
Draws the packed decimal minutes in A and seconds at $24 in the HUD, adding $F3 to each decimal digit to get its glyph code.

Decrements the tick divider at $2A. When it passes through zero and $13 allows a tick, resets it to $30 and subtracts one in BCD from seconds at $24. A borrow wraps seconds to $59 and decrements minutes at $25. At zero it sets the out-of-time flags at $33 and $13.
Acts when phase $1E is zero. While bit 0 of $3F is set, counts down $3D, alternates a colour setting late in the countdown, and clears the bit at expiry.
Adds the selected row displacement to the current map pointer, patches the indexed load, and checks its row bound. In the stage path with $749B negative it translates the tile through $9200.
Swaps 192 bytes from each of two resident tables with the character areas at $C800 and $C8C0. The two copies are exchanged so the routine can restore the previous cells.
Checks $6B bit 7 before calling the music entry at $5506. Sound effects are controlled by bit 0 and reach the driver at $5104 when the intervening game-state check allows it.
Maps 80 tile codes in $C280-$C2CF through $9200 into the two corresponding colour RAM rows at $DA80.
Reads the default palette triplet from $9093-$9095 and falls into the operand patching code at $2AAD.
Returns the high nibble of A plus $1B in Y and the low nibble plus $1B in A for insertion into message data.
Restores $0080-$00F2 and $5510-$5540 from the buffers saved at $C000 and $C080 on shop entry. Brackets the copies with the shared audio-service guard in $2A56.
Reads the stage's six colour entries at $A228-$A22D, transforms each through $7200 and patches the immediate operands in the top and middle playfield IRQs.
Eight bytes per glyph for the letter and number shapes read at $1383. The message renderer masks the glyph code to six bits before indexing.
Indexed operand base for the first copy at $1196. Y descends from $C8 to 1, reading the panel frame and label cells at $3894–$395B.
Indexed operand base for the second HUD copy at $11A1. Y descends from $50 to 1, reading the bottom panel cells at $395C–$39AB.
Dispatches to $4C3E for per-stage actor state initialisation.
Dispatches to $4BB5 to clear the spawn buffers and indices.
Zeros two 100-byte arrays at $0600 and $0664 and two eight-byte arrays at $4CF0 and $4D00 before resetting the operand at $486A.
Takes three bits of the byte from $4BE9 to seed the slot search, walks backwards across eight slots, and uses the first zero flag in $4D00.

Marks the selected slot in $4D00 and reads its corresponding entries from the five eight-byte tables at $9300-$9327. Patches the copy source, sets $01 to $30 and copies a 64-byte record from payload RAM at $4C30 before restoring $35.
Tests command byte $5100. The $7F path marks the event inactive in $F1 and clears the voice-three envelope and control registers before joining the routine exit path.
Selector entry jumps to $59E4 to initialise the music driver.
Maintenance entry jumps to $558B and is called immediately after a stage payload load.
Per-service entry jumps to $550B. Reached from $2A5D when the music toggle permits it.
Contains banner text including GET READY, GAME OVER, PAUSED and OUT OF TIME. The renderer at $132E reads a twelve-character window and maps @ to glyph zero with its six-bit mask.
Used at $1A31 to select one of four 2 KB playfield character pages by ORing the table byte into the base VIC pointer value.
The shop comparison at $1FEC indexes this table using the stage number stored at $998C.
Reads the packed stream bit by bit. Literal runs take bytes from the drive and copy them backwards to the destination. Backreferences copy from later addresses in that same output.
Stores a literal at the descending output pointer $FC/$FD plus Y.
Stores a backreference byte at the descending destination. The source pointer was formed from the destination and decoded match distance.
Shifts bits from $FB into A and $A7. Refills the shift register from the drive when the sentinel bit shifts out.
Drops five stack bytes and returns to the surrounding loader. The monitored stage-two load reached this exit with $FC/$FD equal to $9080.
Subtracts the decoded span length in $A8 from $FC/$FD, propagating the borrow to the high byte.
Sets logical file and device eight, opens the file and talks to the drive. Reads five stream header bytes into $FB-$FF before switching off ROM and I/O for the initial decoder dispatch.

Selects KERNAL and I/O in $01, cycles a VIC mirror for load stripes and counts down the byte count. When bytes remain it receives the next serial byte and banks RAM back in with $01 zero. Exhaustion branches to $7638 before the receive.
Saves the processor port and border colour, selects KERNAL and I/O, invokes the packed file reader and restores both saved settings on return.
Saves zero-page bytes $02-$FF to $7792-$788F before loading. Suppresses display and sound while loading and restores the zero page and processor port afterwards.
Adds ASCII '1' to the pre-load stage index at $02A7, writes the digit into the three-byte filename at $778E, calls the disk reader and increments the index on return.
Three bytes passed to SETNAM, a digit followed by dot and star. The loader rewrites the digit at $773D.
Temporary backing store for $02-$FF while the disk decoder uses zero page. Written at $76E3 and restored at $771C.
Loads the playfield display value $1B and waits twice for a raster-side update to clear $59.
Uses A for the next raster line and X/Y for the next handler address. Acknowledges the VIC interrupt, restores A/X/Y from $03-$05 and executes RTI.
Configures the 6510 port and CIA interrupt masks. On its boot path it calls the disk loader for payload one, then initialises music and installs the title raster chain.
Selects a CIA1 keyboard column and reads $DC01. Debounces the F1/F3 bit changes and toggles $6B bits 7 and 0. Restores CIA1 port A to $7F.
Saves the interrupted registers, changes VIC display and memory settings for the lower title area, then updates music and optionally invokes the title animation routines.
Reads joystick port 2 and tests bit 4. Stores the previous fire bit in the operand at $818C so a held button is filtered.
